structured_data_candidates.data: MSP values by crop, marketing season, year, unit, announcement date
structured_data_candidates.why_not_primarily_rag: Values are season-specific and must support exact numeric lookup and historical comparisons.
structured_data_candidates.suggested_table: msp_prices(source_id, crop_id, season, year, amount, unit, published_at, effective_from, source_version_id)
structured_data_candidates.later_query: Filter by crop and marketing season/year; return value with source and effective date.

structured_data_candidates.why_not_primarily_rag: Exact contact values can change and require deterministic lookup and verification dates.
structured_data_candidates.suggested_table: official_contacts(contact_id, scheme_id, department, contact_type, value, jurisdiction, source_id, source_version_id, last_verified)
structured_data_candidates.later_query: Filter by scheme, issue, jurisdiction, and contact type; return only current verified records.

structured_data_candidates.data: Application URLs, offices, service channels, addresses
structured_data_candidates.why_not_primarily_rag: URLs and routing are operational data; stale links or office details can misdirect users.
structured_data_candidates.suggested_table: scheme_channels(channel_id, scheme_id, channel_type, url_or_address, jurisdiction, source_id, source_version_id, effective_from, effective_until)
structured_data_candidates.later_query: Resolve by scheme, service, and location; filter by effective period and verified source.

structured_data_candidates.data: Required documents and conditional eligibility/application requirements
structured_data_candidates.why_not_primarily_rag: Requirements need structured filters by scheme and applicant condition and should not be generalized across schemes.
structured_data_candidates.suggested_table: scheme_requirements(requirement_id, scheme_id, applicant_condition, requirement_type, value, source_id, source_version_id, effective_from, effective_until)
structured_data_candidates.later_query: Filter by scheme and applicant conditions; return applicable requirements with provenance.

structured_data_candidates.data: District/crop indicators and derived risk features
structured_data_candidates.why_not_primarily_rag: These are keyed indicators and model outputs better queried deterministically, with derived scores distinguished from official facts.
structured_data_candidates.suggested_table: agricultural_indicators(indicator_id, geography_id, crop_id, season, value, unit, source_id, source_version_id, observed_at, is_model_derived, model_version)
structured_data_candidates.later_query: Join by stable district/crop identifiers and time period; label official observations and model-derived outputs separately.

structured_data_candidates.data: Potentially dynamic benefit amounts, eligibility conditions, scheme availability, application windows
structured_data_candidates.why_not_primarily_rag: Exact amounts, dates, eligibility gates, and availability require effective-dated answers and may change by season, location, or scheme.
structured_data_candidates.suggested_table: scheme_terms(term_id, scheme_id, term_type, value, unit, condition_json, jurisdiction, source_id, source_version_id, effective_from, effective_until)
structured_data_candidates.later_query: Resolve terms for scheme, applicant conditions, location, and date; present the cited version and validity period.

derived_model_content.recommendation: Store as versioned application/model rules with rule_id, model_version, inputs, thresholds, outputs, rationale, and source_basis. Never label the rules as government policy.
Separate official source observations from KisaanSaathi risk thresholds, scores, and classifications; version the model and retain its input provenance.
